digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge and canary workflow scheduling
propositions: reconcile-bridge cron schedule must be halved from */20 (20-minute) to uniform 40-minute cadence expressed as three entries over a 2-hour cycle
reconcile-bridge-canary cron schedule must be halved from hourly (0 * * * *) to 2-hourly (0 */2 * * *)
canary staleness alert window must be doubled from 2 hours to 4 hours to maintain 3x cadence margin

optional RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS chain must pace re-dispatch by sleeping for the pass elapsed duration (capped at 900s, skipped if elapsed exceeds 1800s) before redispatching, doubling inter-invocation period
Jenkinsfile backstop cron must mirror the GitHub three-entry 40-minute backstop cycle
all documentation and comments naming */20 or hourly cadence must be updated to reflect 40-minute and 2-hourly schedules
